operational_failures.observed: Initial planning generator rejected repeated requests
operational_failures.recovery: Case-specific fields were required before any file was written.

operational_failures.observed: First focused distinctness correction left checkpoint duplicates
operational_failures.recovery: The remaining duplicate group was enumerated.

operational_failures.observed: Diagnostic build still exited on the enumerated duplicate groups
operational_failures.recovery: The checkpoint identifier was made case-specific.

operational_failures.observed: Initial Git add was refused by inherited sparse-checkout rules
operational_failures.recovery: Git add --sparse staged only literal Auren paths without changing shared sparsity.

operational_failures.observed: A broad privacy regex mistook a SHA-256 prefix for a task identifier
operational_failures.recovery: The classifier was narrowed to the actual hyphenated identifier shape.

operational_failures.observed: X2 forEach passed an index into a text-length validator
operational_failures.recovery: Two callback sites were changed to explicit one-argument closures.

operational_failures.observed: X2 used a distinct ContractError class outside the inherited evaluator
operational_failures.recovery: X2 reused the exported x1 error class.

operational_failures.observed: The public x2 candidate imported an owner-local x1 filename
operational_failures.recovery: The portable candidate now imports ../x1/core.txt and was hash-rebound.

operational_failures.observed: MetaToolBox rejected a descriptive unsupported catalogue schema label
operational_failures.recovery: Only the label was corrected to the exact supported v2 enum.

operational_failures.observed: The in-app browser URL policy blocked the local HTML file URL
operational_failures.recovery: No bypass was attempted; static checks remain and browser interaction stays open.
